about: Definition of the enabler-free Intel-free variant (how it works: packaging/public/ARCHITECTURE.md): the Intel-free add-on and profile of release/intel_free.json, entered through a libxess_fg.dll proxy for Intel's unmodified XeFG runtime instead of the XeSSMFG enabler, so the package needs no XeSSMFG component and passes release/check_intel_free.py without an allowance. Without the enabler XeFG generates one frame per real frame (2x), Intel's limit for GPUs other than its own, so everything that exists for 3x/4x or for the enabler is left out. Read by release/build_proxy.py and release/assemble.py --variant intel-free-2x.

dropped_defines.XEFG_MFG_RESEARCH=1: Multi-frame network and its model census (31/58 buffers, mfg-finish kernels, late model sets). Intel's runtime alone initialises only the 27-buffer native set at 2x; without this definition the census is that set, sealed once the context is initialised, as in the lib2x library line that ran this runtime at 2x.
dropped_defines.XEFG_MFG_POOL=1: Pooled model sets and pipelines: they exist for the model sets and pipelines the SDK recreates at a multiplier change; one factor here.
dropped_defines.XEFG_MFG_RETIRE=1: Heap and list retirement at multiplier changes; it also depends on the scaling code's frame lock. Without it the scoped owners keep the shader-visible heaps they track until the context is destroyed (lib2x behaviour).
dropped_defines.XEFG_MFG_XELL_PACE=1: Frame-start pacer: it acts at 3x/4x only, reads the factor from the enabler's ApplyMultiplier hook and inline-hooks XeLL and the SDK's Present; none of that exists or is needed at 2x. The pacing layer still learns from the accelerated counters when XeFG generates.
dropped_defines.XEFG_MFG_NO_ENABLER_UI=1: Hook on the enabler's overlay; no enabler.
dropped_defines.XEFG_FRAME_CAP_RESEARCH=1: Generated-frame scaling code, inert in the Intel-free build (scaling forced off); compiled out whole here. The FRAME_CAP summary lines are gone with it.
dropped_defines.XEFG_FLOW_CAP_RESEARCH=1: Flow-preprocessing half of the same scaling code, inert in the Intel-free build; compiled out whole.

hooks.about: release/proxy_common.py API_HOOKS, as wrappers of this proxy's own exports. Each replacement must match its hook's code once.
